meta.name: We Are All Trying Here
meta.description: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After 20 years trying to make his debut film, Hwang Dong-man flails through life, irritating his director friends — until one day he meets Byeon Eun-a.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While Dong-man deals with rock bottom, Ko Hye-jin delivers devastating news. Meanwhile, Eun-a seeks counseling as she struggles at work.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Dong-man slowly grows closer to Eun-a. Later, he makes an enemy of Park Gyeong-se — whose film opens to negative critical reception.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Gyeong-se sets his revenge against Dong-man in motion — playing dirty. Meanwhile, Eun-a faces mounting hostility and pressure at work.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tired of enduring contempt from his peers, Dong-man confronts Gyeong-se. He later chastises Ma Jae-yeong over his relationship with Eun-a.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Days like this are worth living.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: As Dong-man and Eun-a's bond deepens, they both make decisions about their scripts. Eun-a and Oh Jeong-hui finally come face-to-face in a tense moment.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When Dong-man learns that Jae-yeong is about to begin filming, he becomes consumed by envy. Meanwhile, Eun-a decides to confront Jeong-hui directly.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Just as Dong-man is about to debut, his fears haunt him — but Eun-a offers her brand of support. Meanwhile, Eun-a's secret script garners interest.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Desperate to cast Noh Kang-sik, Dong-man takes matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Eun-a grows uneasy as Jeong-hui involves herself in her project.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: An envious man seeks inner peace while feeling isolated in a world where others seem to always succeed.

meta.slogan: Everyone is pretending to be okay… but no one really is.
